title: Workspace aspects (workspace_aspects.yaml)
description: The settings of the aspect guidelines' workspace level beside workspace_aspects.md, in the Tom root or a workspace folder. The workspace level sits between each aspect's default and the quest default; a nearer workspace folder's entry overrides the root's per aspect. The choices themselves are the `@<path>` lines of workspace_aspects.md.

remove.description: The aspects (folders of _ai/aspect_guidelines/) this workspace sends nothing for: Remove on the workspace level. It wins over a choice of the same aspect in workspace_aspects.md beside it.
